scope: Optional staged IMAGE inspector canonical common-entity profile; no consumer or native qualification
observations: The opt-in profile checks the emitted self/owner, ordered subclass boundaries, layer 0, ByLayer linetype, ByLayer color and lineweight, and rejects application groups, unsupported common and unknown raster fields.

Fast generated tests cover R2000 through R2018, ASCII and binary, both compatibility profiles, modified common fields, destination-preserving failure and corrected retry. Existing R14 generic reference tests remain unchanged.
Focused test passed on macOS ARM64 and under AddressSanitizer; leak detection is unavailable on this macOS ASan runtime.
limits: The canonical check is not a general IMAGE common-field validator and does not establish producer or native consumer semantics.
